text:
Avery Johnson: got a prospect asking some SAML/SCIM edge cases and I don’t want to guess. can someone sanity check + point me to the right doc? (this is for a regulated buyer, likely Private/VPC)

Avery Johnson: SAML questions:
1) their IdP metadata has *two* signing certs + two ACS endpoints. do we accept metadata with multiple KeyDescriptors / ACS URLs?
2) they want to use a custom EntityID (not our default) because they have an internal IdP catalog. supported?
3) they do IdP-initiated flows only (no SP-initiated). do we support IdP-initiated SSO?
4) they’re asking about NameID formats (email vs persistent) + whether we require signed assertions

Avery Johnson: SCIM questions:
1) Okta SCIM group push + deprovisioning → do we support group-based role mapping or just provisioning users?
2) they rotate SCIM bearer tokens quarterly; can we have overlapping tokens during rotation?

Avery Johnson: if it’s easier I can open a support-style ticket and route it to the right folks.

Olga Petrov: thanks for flagging. please do *not* promise “supports any metadata shape” etc. :grimacing:

Olga Petrov: quick answers (but I want eng to confirm):
- multiple signing certs: usually ok (cert rollover), but depends on parser + whether they include encryption certs.
- multiple ACS endpoints: we typically expect a single ACS URL per app; if they have multiple, we need to confirm which one they’ll use.

Naomi Feldman: +1 to ticket. these are the kind of questions that turn into a week of back/forth if we answer in slack.

Naomi Feldman: doc pointers while we wait:
- internal SSO/SCIM overview: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SEC/SSO+%26+SCIM+Overview
- SAML config notes (incl. signed assertions): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SEC/SAML+Configuration+Notes
- SCIM provisioning behavior: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SEC/SCIM+Provisioning

Naomi Feldman: Avery can you confirm which IdP (Okta vs Azure AD vs Ping)? and are they asking for multiple IdPs per tenant or just cert rollover?

Avery Johnson: Okta. mostly cert rollover + they have two ACS URLs bc they have “prod” and “pre-prod” in the same metadata export (🙃). they want us to pick the prod one.

Markus Klein: jumping in. from SE side: we’ve seen the “combined metadata” thing. generally we can’t auto-select the right ACS if there are two; we need the customer to provide the exact ACS URL / Audience (EntityID) they want configured.

Markus Klein: IdP-initiated: works as long as the assertion has the right Audience + ACS and they map to the correct org. but we still recommend SP-initiated for debugging.

Colin O'Donnell: on EntityID: today it’s basically derived from the org/app slug in our config. we *can* set a custom EntityID in some cases but it’s not self-serve and we need to be careful (breaks when customers copy/paste between envs).

Evan Scott: re: “require signed assertions” — we require the response/assertion to be signed (standard security posture). if their Okta app is set to unsigned, we’ll reject.

Evan Scott: multiple certs in metadata is fine for rollover (we store the active signing cert(s)), but if they include an encryption cert in there too, we need to make sure we’re validating the correct one.

Daniel Carter: SCIM:
- we support create/update/deactivate users + basic group ingestion.
- role mapping from groups is limited today (not arbitrary custom roles). we can map groups → “viewer/admin” style roles in the console, but not fine-grained RBAC per group.

Daniel Carter: token rotation: we *don’t* currently support multiple active SCIM tokens per org. best practice is schedule a short window, rotate, verify provisioning, then revoke old token. (we should confirm if product wants to change this)

Olga Petrov: ok, we need this crisp for sales. Avery please open a ticket with the exact questions + prospect context so we can provide an approved response.

Avery Johnson: will do. should this be SUP or ENG?

Naomi Feldman: SUP. tag as “SSO/SCIM - pre-sales” and link this thread. we can pull in eng as needed.

Jira Bot: Avery Johnson created ticket SUP-51214 “SAML/SSO metadata validation + SCIM token rotation questions (pre-sales)” and assigned it to Olga Petrov. https://jira.redwoodinference.com/browse/SUP-51214

Avery Johnson: added notes + pasted their metadata excerpts + the “two ACS URLs” situation. also noted they’re asking for custom EntityID.

Markus Klein: thx. for your immediate reply to the prospect (until ticket response is ready):
- “We support Okta SAML + SCIM provisioning; for combined metadata exports (multiple ACS/certs), we’ll confirm the single ACS + EntityID values to configure for your production environment.”
- “We require signed SAML responses/assertions.”

Olga Petrov: +1. also avoid saying “HIPAA-ready” / “compliant” etc in the same email. keep it scoped to SSO/SCIM capability.

Evan Scott: if they’re stuck on IdP-initiated-only, ask them to test SP-initiated once during setup for troubleshooting, but we won’t block on it.

Naomi Feldman: I’ll draft an approved blurb in SUP-51214 once we confirm the custom EntityID constraints. Colin/Markus can you confirm whether we can support it for Private deployments without a code change?

Colin O'Donnell: yep, will check with platform auth config today and update the ticket.

Avery Johnson: perfect. thanks all.
